problem: Which of the following values is in the range of $y=\operatorname{arccos}⁡x?$

feedback.problem: Which of the following values is in the domain of $y=\operatorname{arccos}⁡x?$
feedback.worked_solution:
Let's recall the graph of $y=\operatorname{arccos}⁡x.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14006797/assets/9dcc5a116c2a564547283783a7df7b1cd3a9ab3b76ac24dc2695c4cb367796d5.png)

Note that:

- The domain of the function is $[-1,1].$

Therefore, of the given values, only $x=\frac{1}{\pi }$ is in the domain of $y=\operatorname{arccos}⁡x.$
